# #3551: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S01, the patches to shipped cards
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It patches the shipped cards: the six the designer named (Jay Fungus, Selective Breeding, Rotten Grape, Money Machine, Heroic Power, Great Paperclip Theory), plus the shipped-card side of E3 and E5. Those were held back so that their engine work could merge on `main` without changing how any shipped card plays. Everything here goes live with the set, in fullsend 1's one pull request.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP4, SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).
